messages:
dave r: noticed a small regression in eu1 embeddings after the last canary, about 0.25% errors hitting kvcache lookup. want to push hotfix in late window, requesting expedited approvals.
lena k: can you paste minimal repro / logs?
dave r: short log:```
ERROR embeddings-eu1: kvcache keytype mismatch for hash x7f3
stack: embeddings/quant_lookup.go:142
```
maria chen: what's the rollback plan and perf impact?
dave r: rollback = pin previous image v2026-03-embed-9 (fast rollback command below). perf impact negligible in bench (~+0.3ms p50).
lena k: given late window, prefer compressed canary: 5% for 5m then 50% for 8m then 100% if green. if >0.6% errors or latency p95 +10% rollback.
dave r: proposed command:```
/deploy embeddings-eu1 v2026-03-hotfix-21 --pin --expedite --canary=5% --smoke=5m
```
maria chen: relnotes draft: "hotfix: embeddings-eu1 kvcache type-check guard + cache regen; mitigates sporadic lookup errors" will push PR. link: https://go/relnotes/PR-1407
release-bot: Deployment request created by dave r for service=embeddings-eu1 version=v2026-03-hotfix-21 image=sha256:def456. Approvers: eng-release, sres, product.
dave r: kicking deploy now.
release-bot: deploy started: canary=5% at 1787778892. logs: https://go/logs/deploy/1787778888
lena k: watching dashboards. opening a short incident channel if thresholds trip.
maria chen: relnotes PR created and tagged product. PR link posted.
release-bot: canary 5% after 5m: error rate=0.03%, p95 latency +0.2ms. green.
dave r: bump to 50% for 8m. executed.
release-bot: ramp to 50% at 1787778925.
lena k: 6m in at 50%: error rate 0.08%, still within thresholds.
dave r: going to 100% over 6m.
release-bot: final ramp complete at 1787778978. traffic 100%.
maria chen: relnotes merged and sent to customers in the late window email.
lena k: marking approval here. rollback command if needed:```
/deploy rollback embeddings-eu1 v2026-03-embed-9
```
dave r: thanks all. will monitor for 30m then clear watch. tagging follow-up if any regressions. :thumbsup:
